entries.speaker: Activity Log
entries.en: By connecting online, you can see the actions[n]other players chose to perform at the current[n]time on the same day.

entries.speaker: Activity Log
entries.en: Press [clr 2][f 1 10 65][clr 27] and select Network to see the[n]activity log of other players. This feature will[n]not affect the gameplay or story.

entries.speaker: Activity Log
entries.en: To turn this feature off, open the main menu[n]by pressing [f 1 10 25], then select [clr 2]System[clr 27], [clr 2]Config[clr 27],[n]then [clr 2]Network Functions[clr 27].
